svg.title: BenchGen Router Lite architecture
svg.desc: A query is embedded by a frozen Qwen3-1.7B backbone, routed by a lightweight Router Head, and answered by one selected candidate model, whose reply is returned to the user. Each stage lights up as the query passes through it, and the selected model changes from query to query.

g.text: A lightweight router learns which language
fixed positions, one selected per query
